items.prompt: Write a letter to a pen friend. Tell them about your town and your family. Write at least eight sentences.
hints: Say hello and who you are.
Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: Say hello and who you are.
Ask a question at the end.
items.model: Dear Sam, my name is Dina and I live in Jakarta. It is a big, busy city. My family has four people: my mother, my father, my brother and me. We often visit the park on Sundays. There are many tall buildings and lots of traffic here. I like my town because the food is delicious. What is your town like? Please write back soon. Best wishes, Dina

items.prompt: Do you think children should help at home? Write your opinion with three reasons. Use words like firstly, also and finally.
hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

items.model: I think children should help at home. Firstly, it teaches them to be responsible. Also, it makes their parents happy and less tired. Finally, doing jobs together is a good way to spend time as a family.

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Write a story about a strange night. Use at least two adjectives and one question.

figure.alt: The moon, an owl and a forest.

hints: What does the place look like?
Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

planning: What does the place look like?
items.model: The moon was bright and round over the dark forest. Suddenly, a wise old owl hooted three times. Who was calling me? I followed the sound and found a tiny, glowing lantern hanging from a branch. It was the start of a magical adventure.

items.prompt: Write a report about an animal you know well. Say where it lives, what it eats and why it is special.

figure.alt: A lion, an elephant and a penguin.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

items.model: The elephant is the largest land animal. It lives in Africa and Asia. It eats grass, leaves and fruit. Elephants are special because they have excellent memories and live in close families.

items.prompt: Write about a problem in your neighbourhood and how people can solve it. Write at least eight sentences.
hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

items.model: In my neighbourhood there is too much rubbish on the street. It looks ugly and it can make people ill. We could put more bins near the shops. Children can also help by picking up litter on Saturdays. If everyone does a little, our street will be clean and safe.
